alerts.title: Prescribed Fire Area Closure - Baker Creek
alerts.description: Due to a prescribed burn in the area, the following areas are closed to public access: Pole Canyon, Timber Creek, Baker Creek, and Baker Lake. Call the park for up to date information.

alerts.title: Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive Winter Closure
alerts.description: Wheeler Peak Scenic Drive is closed to vehicle traffic at Osceola Ditch (4.5 miles up the road) for winter weather.

alerts.title: No Potable Water in Park Campgrounds
alerts.description: There is no water available in any campground in Great Basin National Park.  Water is available at the Great Basin Visitor Center and the Lehman Caves Visitor Center.
